description: What a poll will cost, from the same prices the worker charges by: one run's typical and 95th-percentile charge, what a run holds from the balance while it runs, and what starting the poll commits (hold per run times the runs left before its end date, or a month of runs when it has none). Show this to the account holder before start_poll or run_poll_now. (GET /api/v1/polls/{id}/estimate)

id.description: The poll's id, or its public address (slug).

name: estimate_poll
title: Estimate a poll's cost
